label.en: Capital income taxation: national rate schedule (tin_capinc_schedule)

description.en: Capital income taxation: national rate 1 Capital income taxation: limit for rate 1 Capital income taxation: national rate 2 Capital income taxation: limit for rate 2 Capital income taxation: national rate 3 Capital income taxation: limit for rate 3 Capital income taxation: national rate 4 Marginal rate (9.5% latest) for the first band of the national ('estatal') scale applied to savings/capital income under Spain's IRPF, used as Band_Rate in the SchedCalc computing 'cuota C' in both tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'). It applies to savings income up to $tin_capinc_lim1 (6,000 €/year) and is matched by an equal regional rate, $tin_capinc_regrate1 (also 9.5%), consistent with Spain splitting savings-income tax into a state component (cuota C) and a regional component (cuota D). It has 6 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Upper threshold of the first band of the scale applied to savings/capital income (the 'base liquidable del ahorro' — interest, dividends and capital gains) under Spain's personal income tax (IRPF). It is used as the Band_UpLim of a band group in the SchedCalc that computes 'cuota C', the national/state tax on savings income, within both the individual-taxation policy tinit_es and the joint-taxation policy tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income (cuota C del Gravamen estatal ahorro de la base liquidable del ahorro)'). Its used_count of 8, double the 4 seen for the national rate constants, suggests the same threshold is also reused as a Band_UpLim in the parallel regional 'cuota D' schedule, since Spain applies the state and regional savings-tax components over identical income bands. Latest value 6,000 €/year, with 2 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Marginal rate (10.5% latest) for the second band of the national scale applied to savings/capital income under Spain's IRPF, used as Band_Rate in the SchedCalc computing 'cuota C' in tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'). It applies to the portion of savings income between $tin_capinc_lim1 and $tin_capinc_lim2 (50,000 €/year), matched by an equal regional rate ($tin_capinc_regrate2, also 10.5%) that together form the combined state-plus-region marginal rate on that band. It has 5 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Upper threshold of the second band of Spain's savings/capital-income tax scale ('base liquidable del ahorro') under IRPF, used as Band_UpLim in the SchedCalc computing the national 'cuota C' in both tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'). Together with $tin_capinc_lim1 it delimits the range to which the second-band rate ($tin_capinc_natrate2, and its regional counterpart $tin_capinc_regrate2) applies; its used_count of 8, versus 4 for the single-schedule rate constants, again suggests it is shared with the parallel regional 'cuota D' schedule. Latest value 50,000 €/year, with 3 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Marginal rate (11.5% latest) for the third band of the national scale applied to savings/capital income under Spain's IRPF, used as Band_Rate in the SchedCalc computing 'cuota C' in tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'). It applies to the portion of savings income between $tin_capinc_lim2 and $tin_capinc_lim3 (200,000 €/year), matched by an equal regional rate ($tin_capinc_regrate3, also 11.5%). It has 5 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Upper threshold of the third band of Spain's savings/capital-income tax scale ('base liquidable del ahorro') under IRPF, used as Band_UpLim in the SchedCalc computing the national 'cuota C' in both tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'). Because SchedCalc leaves the last band's upper limit open-ended (infinite) by default, this is the final explicit threshold in the schedule: above it, the top-band rate ($tin_capinc_natrate4) applies without a further, separate limit constant. Latest value 200,000 €/year, with 2 recorded values since 2005-01-01. Marginal rate (13.5% latest) for the fourth and top band of the national scale applied to savings/capital income under Spain's IRPF, used as Band_Rate in the SchedCalc computing 'cuota C' in tinit_es and tinjt_es (site comment 'National Tax credits on capital income'), applying to savings income above $tin_capinc_lim3 (200,000 €/year) in the schedule's open-ended final band. Unlike $tin_capinc_natrate1-3 (used_count 4, matching the regional rates $tin_capinc_regrate1-3), this constant's used_count is 8 — the same as the shared band thresholds $tin_capinc_lim1-3 — which suggests it may also be reused as the top-band Band_Rate of the parallel regional 'cuota D' schedule, since no separate $tin_capinc_regrate4 appears in this batch. It has 3 recorded values since 2005-01-01; the reuse hypothesis is inferred from usage-count patterns rather than confirmed by a document.

explanation.en: Assembled from params.parameter_groups ES:tin_cons_es:tin_capinc_schedule (band 1 rate=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_natrate1, band 1 upper_threshold=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_lim1, band 2 rate=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_natrate2, band 2 upper_threshold=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_lim2, band 3 rate=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_natrate3, band 3 upper_threshold=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_lim3, band 4 rate=euromod://ES/tin_cons_es/def_const/$tin_capinc_natrate4). EUROMOD's role is upper_threshold; brackets carry the band's lower bound.
